notes.title: Chapter 3: DevLog#5
notes.content:
Hello Rebels!

I hope you are all in good health!
I'm here to bring some update on the progress!

Things have been a bit slow in the past few weeks, but I'm trying my best to keep it up.
Here is a rough indication of where I'm at:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545234/b2b70eddc5aca74feaf42f27645f87daaf83300a.jpg[/img]
I have to admit, that I've been struggling a bit with the two encircled scenes.
I hope I can progress more efficiently in the coming weeks.

Here's what I have so far:
Updated NEW asset count for this chapter:
- BG: 7
- CG: 14
- Chara: 15
- Creature: 1
- Items: 5
- Music: 6

There was mostly work done for CG's and for new characters.
By the way, I just realized that there are currently 46 unique characters in the story. That's quite amazing!

I'm also happy to announce that I was able to do a quick-fix that activates the Steam overlay for both chapter 1 and 2, meaning that screenshots can now be taken. Although, it only works with windows for now. I'll have to find a solution for mac in the future.
Special thanks to Elaine for pointing it out and testing it.

I'm curious to see if there will be new screenshots uploaded into the community section. =)

As always, feel free to leave a comment, and I wish you a great start into the week!
meta.baron
